teaser: Explains how red teams choose adversaries to emulate, drive defensive change through storytelling, and adapt their work to AI-driven attackers.

title: Emulating the Identity First Threat Actor - Automated Playbooks for IdP Hijacking
teaser: Shows how to emulate identity-first intrusions across Active Directory, Entra ID and cloud control planes, and score detection coverage with repeatable playbooks.

title: Field Notes on Offensive Agents - Reusability, Reliability
teaser: Shares lessons from building reusable, reliable offensive AI agents for client web application tests, covering evaluation and safety controls.

title: Haetae - An Agent to Takedown N.Korean C2 Servers
teaser: Shows how an AI agent built on Ruby and simple HTTP tools finds and exploits weak North Korean malware C2 servers, with an emulator for safe practice.

title: From threat intel to tested defense the adversary simulation playbook
teaser: Panelists discuss how to turn threat intelligence into adversary simulation exercises that test whether detections and controls actually hold up.

title: Hey Adversary, I’ve Got a Human EDR Bypass for You
teaser: Shows how red teams read security awareness metrics, OSINT and employee habits to gain initial access without advanced code, and how defenders can respond.

title: Microsoft and Amazon are my Favorite C2 Providers
teaser: Shows how Microsoft Azure Relay and AWS IoT services can carry command-and-control traffic that blends into trusted cloud endpoints.

title: MCPwned - How Exposed AI Agents Became the Internet’s New Recon Toy
teaser: Shows how internet scanners and attackers target exposed LLM gateways, MCP servers and local inference APIs, based on a multi-persona AI honeypot.

title: SEND - Teaching Machines to Lie to Defenders
teaser: Presents SEND, a framework that pairs cheap attacker actions with LLM-generated fake artifacts to mislead SOC analysts' investigation narratives.

title: Where hackers find their people, and security finds its strength
teaser: A panel of DEF CON organizers and community leaders shares how mentorship, welcoming villages and local meetups help newcomers find their place in security.

title: Yet Another Walking Dead of Active Directory
teaser: Shows how disabled and deleted Active Directory objects keep dangerous permissions and recoverable data, with open-source tools to find and abuse them.

title: Behind the Badge - SAOv3 and Open Sourcing the Aerospace Village ISS Badge
teaser: Presents SAOv3, a draft add-on standard for conference badges, plus open-source OLED animation tooling that removes screen tearing.

title: Aerospace Cybersecurity Student Research Spotlight Cal Poly
teaser: Pairs a ptrace-based process injection chain against CubeSat flight software with a pipeline that maps hidden C and C++ dependencies in satellite code.

title: Aerospace Cybersecurity Student Research Spotlight ERAU
teaser: Presents two Embry-Riddle student prototypes: an AI log-triage system for aircraft cyber defense and a virtual satellite constellation testbed for security research.

title: Drones, Detectors, and the Kill Chain
teaser: Walks through how drones are detected and mitigated over North American airspace, covering Remote ID, RF control links, legal authority and the gaps in today's counter-drone tools.

title: Cleared for Takeoff - Debunking Uncertifiable Cybersecurity
teaser: Explains how an existing function-randomization defense was made certifiable under DO-178C by producing traceable, verifiable evidence without changing what it does.

title: Hacking AFDX or Not - A Primer for Flight Control Systems Security
teaser: Explains how AFDX, the Ethernet-based avionics network used on modern airliners, differs from office networks, and what probing a test-bench airframe revealed.

title: Hacking Airplanes at the NTSB
teaser: Shows how NTSB vehicle recorder specialists recover and decode undocumented binary logs from damaged aircraft and submarine devices.

title: Hacking Electronic Conspicuity Devices - or - Making Light Aircraft Fly Into Conflict
teaser: Examines how cheap electronic conspicuity boxes that show nearby light aircraft can be abused over Wi-Fi, from weak defaults to firmware memory flaws.

title: Racing PX4 - Memory Safety and Timing Vulnerabilities
teaser: Walks through memory corruption and race-condition flaws in PX4's MAVLink and uORB subsystems that can halt drone missions.

title: So You Want to Work in Aircraft Cyber Heres what you need to know
teaser: Gives cybersecurity professionals a fast overview of the regulations, standards, aircraft systems and skills needed to move into aviation security.

title: Security Analysis of Open Source Software Used in Onboard Satellite Systems -Rose Idan
teaser: Presents an empirical study of 126 open-source satellite flight software repositories, covering maintenance state, severity, weakness types and affected subsystems.

title: SpaceCOP - Houston, We Have an Intrusion
teaser: Introduces SpaceCOP, an open-source onboard intrusion detection system for NASA's Core Flight System that turns SPARTA behavioral indicators into spacecraft detections.

title: Leveraging LLMs for Policy, Regulatory, and Compliance in IoMT - Opportunities, Risks and Safeguards
teaser: Shows how large language models can map medical device policies to HIPAA and NIST guidance, and how prompt injection puts clinical IoT systems at risk.

title: Minimize Harm, Maximize Defense - How Anthropic Navigates the Offense Defense Divide
teaser: Explains how Anthropic sorts cybersecurity requests into four risk categories and why its Fable 5 safety margin blocks more defensive work.

title: Pwning Agentic Browsers with PleaseFix - A New Vulnerability Class for 0 Click Takeover
teaser: Shows how agentic browsers such as Atlas, Comet, Claude in Chrome and Gemini can be hijacked through poisoned pages, calendar invites and browser history.

title: AgentBreaker A blind spot detector for your coding agents
teaser: Shows how a pre-implementation security context step and a small fine-tuned model can make coding agents produce more secure code.

title: SADF - A Taxonomy and Evaluation Framework for Agentic Security Failures
teaser: Introduces an eight-class taxonomy of agentic AI security failures and a refusal-filtered harness showing that the orchestration framework shifts compromise rates.

title: That's Not Your Agent - Why Zero Trust Can't Tell
teaser: Shows why Zero Trust controls miss compromised AI agents, since prompt injection hijacks intent after authentication passes and the logs stay clean.

title: This Wasn't AI Generated - Principles for Breaking Generative Watermarks
teaser: Shows how Google's SynthID image watermark can be stripped with light diffusion regeneration and a fast offline surrogate detector trained on paired images.

title: Trust Amplification in Enterprise AI Systems - MS CoPilot Case Studies
teaser: Shows how indirect prompt injection in Microsoft Copilot can turn document conversions, shared sessions and device code phishing into trusted attack paths, and introduces the Locusta toolkit.

title: What we learned from SATAN about the MYTH of Mythos
teaser: Compares the 1995 release of the SATAN network scanner with today's restricted AI vulnerability tools, arguing that limiting access hurts defenders more than attackers.

title: A Billion User Blast Radius - Owning ChatGPT’s Secure Sandbox
teaser: Shows how a ChatGPT code sandbox was chained into a command-and-control channel using spreadsheet parsing abuse, reasoning injection, and covert signaling over a shared package proxy.

title: Donating Bone Marrow - A Donor's First Hand Experience
teaser: Two donors describe what bone marrow and stem cell donation involves, from the procedures and recovery to how to join the registry.

title: AIRGAP BREACHED - Monitoring Ancestral Payload from the Poles
teaser: Presents a low-cost, open-source eDNA air sampler for catching ancient and airborne DNA as part of climate-linked biosurveillance.

title: Four Newbies Vs - An Insulin Pump - How Hard Can It Be
teaser: Follows four security students as they analyze a Bluetooth Low Energy insulin pump, from threat modeling to spoofing the pump's advertisements to reach the controller.

title: Counting the Dead in the Digital Siege Detection Mapping Patient Harm
teaser: Maps how ransomware attacks on hospitals translate into patient deaths, and how existing coding, certification and legal systems could be adapted to count that harm.

title: DarkSyringe - Automated poisoning of Clinical AI Assistants Through PDFs a physician's POV
teaser: Shows how plausible false medical statements hidden in PDF discharge letters can steer LLM summaries toward harmful treatment advice.

title: Human in the Loop or Human Out of Luck
teaser: Shows how a rare-disease patient's involvement changed what AI-assisted student teams investigated in a Stanford course built on multi-omic data.

title: Hacking Hearts by Reverse Engineering Pacemaker Firmware
